study type: Cross-sectional study with retrospective facility-based data collection
cohort: 239 pregnant women who underwent management for ruptured uterus at Felegehiwot Referral Hospital in Bahir Dar City, Northwest Ethiopia between September 11, 2012, and August 30, 2017
finding: The study found a high incidence of ruptured uterus and associated complications, with prolonged operation time being significantly associated with undesired maternal outcomes.
